prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Upload Step Redesign: Redesigns the photo upload screen using a compact layout with intuitive drop zone and instant verification components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Upload Your Pet Photo", "body": "Upload 1 to 3 clear photos of your pet to generate your customized 3D desktop companion."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Trait Selection Flow: Adds personality trait checklist components directly into the pet selection screen prior to adoption confirmation.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Select companion personality: Playful, Calm, Curious, Energetic", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Certificate Sign In Reorder: Moves account sign-in to appear after the adoption certificate screen instead of before pet selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Readiness Check Screen: Introduces a new screen during generation that tests and confirms desktop overlay permissions before pet spawn.
   config: {"new_desktop_readiness": {"headline": "Checking Desktop Permissions", "body": "Ensuring your desktop pet has proper system overlay permissions to display smoothly on your screen.", "show_progress": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_readiness", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Displays a explicit hint explaining that signing into an existing account restores all previously adopted desktop pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your registered account to automatically restore and sync all existing pets."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Creation Render Progress Activity Stream: Adds dynamic progress status text showing detailed generation steps while waiting for pet creation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "text": "Building 3D pet mesh and desktop animation behaviors..."}]}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Companion Creation Path Clarity Copy: Updates body text on choose_path screen to explicitly differentiate quick ready-made companion vs custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"body": "Select Instant Companion for immediate setup, or Custom Photo Creation to personalize your pet from photos."}}
7: [home, notification] Pet Completion System Notification Alert: Enables desktop readiness notification alerts while pet generation completes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Enable desktop notification to be alerted the second your pet arrives."}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Incentive: Adds an official verification badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet registration.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Desktop Arrival Redesign: Redesigns home_intro to a full_bleed layout with clear instructions on desktop interaction controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Click on your desktop companion anytime to open controls, interact, or customize settings."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of upload_photos screen within onboarding.
Adding trait checklist component to pet selection screen is allowed.
Reordering sign_in to after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding a permission readiness check screen within onboarding is allowed.
Adding sign-in sync hint text is allowed within onboarding.
Adding render progress text to waiting screen fulfills the job of showing the pet is being made.
Copy clearly offers both ready-made adoption and custom photo creation paths.
Adding optional readiness notification alert to waiting screen is allowed.
Adding official verification badge component maintains the required adoption stamp job.
Redesigning home_intro layout and copy inside onboarding is allowed.
